# Bundled modifications and embedded components

This is a locally modified vLLM 0.11.1 snapshot (version.py records commit 6ac0cd370316e7c940d237e803b0eb8eda282f01). The upstream Apache-2.0 license is retained in LICENSE; source headers remain unchanged.

The custom qwen2_code2wav_dit modules contain diffusion/TTS adaptations. Embedded F5-TTS code retains its MIT license in third_party_licenses/LICENSE-F5-TTS; it is not relicensed under vLLM's Apache-2.0 license.
